definitions: NLL: mean -log(max(p_true, probability_floor)); natural logarithm.
Brier: mean sum_k (p_k - onehot_k)^2; not divided by class count.
ECE: sum_bin count/N * abs(observed top-label accuracy - mean confidence).
Equal-width confidence bins are [lower,upper); the last includes 1.
Empty bins have null accuracy/confidence and contribute zero to ECE.

limitations: No complete independent plant, field or capture-session grouping is available.
Source archives overlap and are not independent evaluation domains.

Raw images must not be bundled in the repository, model artifacts, reports or application.

research_policy.user_approval: Phase 10 research use and documented exclusions explicitly authorized

limitations: The old V1 holdout was invalidated by confirmed cross-partition same-parent content; old and new metrics are not comparable independent holdouts.
V2 repairs confirmed identity relations and excludes all confirmed conflicting families, but does not prove plant/field/session independence.
Unresolved Healthy pair 24 crosses TRAIN/VALIDATION; unresolved pair 58 is within TRAIN. Neither is a confirmed identity and neither was silently grouped or excluded.
Classifier-selected validation was reused for diagnostics; calibration cross-fit does not erase classifier validation selection.
The dataset and historical test were inspected; current final TEST metrics are descriptive and never selected weights, temperature or threshold.
Source-domain/class weaknesses and high-confidence errors remain; no operational rejection threshold was locked.
Single CPU seed; independent field validation and multi-seed stability remain pending.
Academic/FYP non-commercial research only; no raw image redistribution or commercial clearance; no production promotion.
